name: Okamoto Maya
source:
In their own words: “It's fun, so it's fine.” “As long as it's interesting, that's good enough.” They're the complete opposite of someone driven by effort or grit.

A laid-back modern kid who goes at their own pace and doesn't dwell on things. Or so it seems—but are they actually scheming?

Someone who wants to be a character from a famous anime.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/senpai/chara/chara.htmll] official site[/url]]
